description: Delete pages from a PDF by number or range — preview the page list, select what to remove, and download the cleaned document.

faqs.a: Type individual pages (2, 5) and ranges (3-7) together, e.g. “2, 5-8, 12”. Pages are 1-based.
faqs.q: How do I specify which pages to delete?

faqs.a: No — only the pages you select are removed; the rest keep their original content and order.
faqs.q: Does it affect the remaining pages?

faqs.a: The file stays on your device the whole time — pdf-lib runs locally in your browser.
Browsers can struggle with extremely large PDFs (hundreds of MB). For typical documents it works fine.

howto: Enter the page numbers or ranges to delete.
Review which pages will be kept.
Click “Delete pages” and download the new PDF.
title: PDF Page Deleter
